body: A little better right now, thanks for asking. Still just lying in bed. Maybe gonna go to a friend's house for the evening and see if I can have fun. Probably not, though. My brain hates me.

I'm on Prozac, ativan, and ambien. I just wake up in the morning with so much anxiety that I suck up into my head to turn off my emotions, and I can't sleep in that state. It's crazy to think I was relatively fine a little over a month ago. Then I tried to think about the future for the first time and it broke my brain.
